text:
My pick is the **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand (Qi2 25W)**. I couldn't read the WIRED roundup. It was too large for my fetch tool, so this is based on the Macworld review and the ESR product page.

**Best overall: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand, $129.99**
- It charges the iPhone at up to 25W (Qi2.2). Macworld says wireless charging doesn't get faster than that.
- The Apple Watch module and the AirPods pad are both rated at 5W. Macworld says that's enough to fast-charge the Watch.
- It's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested. It lifts the iPhone more than 70mm, and the hinge gives a 160° viewing angle. That suits FaceTime calls and desk use.
- It folds to 152 × 90 × 30mm and weighs 399g. It comes with a 45W adapter, UK and EU plug adapters, and a 4-ft cable.
- The downside is size. It's about 250g heavier than the compact rivals.
- Buy: [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V?tag=macworld05-20&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1) · [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w) · [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW) · [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html)

**Best value: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W stand, about $82 with a code**
- It has an active cooling fan and a 50W adapter included.
- The list price is $99.99. Dealectric says code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23, which brings it to about $82. The code expires 2026-12-31, and checkout has the final word.
- ESR's product page says 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- ESR doesn't publish the stand's dimensions. A 15W version costs $79.99.
- Buy: [ESR's US store, via Dealectric's affiliate link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). Dealectric earns a commission, and you pay nothing extra.
- I couldn't confirm that this fan model is the same as the ESR foldable travel charger Macworld reviewed. That one costs $99.99 and lifts the iPhone only about 20mm.

**Other options Macworld mentions** (I haven't checked their prices or details):
- **Kuxiu X40 Turbo ($79.99):** the most compact when folded, and it raises the iPhone about 35mm.
- **Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1:** a fast 25W stand with a designer look.
- **Anker Prime 3-in-1 MagGo:** a fast stand with a display, but not one to travel with.
- **Ugreen MagFlow Pro 3-in-1 25W:** has a cooling fan. Macworld reviewed it on Oct 13, 2026.

If it lives on your desk or nightstand, get the Satechi. If you want a cheaper 25W stand with a fan, get the ESR. If you travel a lot, look at the Kuxiu. Check that your iPhone model supports 25W before paying extra for it.
